title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode2 The Fourth Childhood Friend

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(This is a good album, all the songs on it are
great. I'll add them to my favorites playlist.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, I can't add any more songs to this one?
Looks like I filled it up with nothing but Miku songs...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess that just goes to show how many people choose Miku to sing the songs they write.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's amazing. She can sing any song, in any style.
She can do anything.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Unlike me...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika? Um, hi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How have you been—

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Morning, Honami! Did you do all of the problems for today's math class?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Sorry, a friend's calling me. I've got to go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Classmate
rows.Line: Hi, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Classmate
rows.Line: Huh? You're looking down today. Something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not really.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Classmate
rows.Line: I guess you look like that most days. You know, you have that somber air about you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haha, what are you talking about? Anyway, do you mind showing me your math homework...
Uhm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Hello, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Classmate
rows.Line: That Hinomori's got attitude. She's cool, but also kind of scary, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's not really anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Classmate
rows.Line: Sorry, did you say something, Ichika? Oh shoot. Class is about to start! Come on, or we'll be late!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They didn't want to talk to me. Again.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess they don't consider me a friend anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Everyone's in their seats, I hope. We have a new student joining us from today. Come in.
Yes, Ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, it's nice to meet you all! My name's Saki Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've actually been a student here since junior high school, but I ended up in the hospital for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now I'm back to perfect health, and ready to have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
My plan is to enjoy high school life to the fullest♪
Let's all be friends!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
I'm counting on everyone to help Ms. Tenma settle in.
Ms. Tenma, your seat is over there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Hoshino! Let's be friends♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you joker... Why didn't you tell me you were coming back to school?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! Sorry, but I wanted it to be surprise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, you succeeded at that. But you know what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really happy you're back. I missed you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, don't talk like that with a serious face!
You're going to make me tear up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... But I really meant it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can finally all hang out together again, just like we used to!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, um...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, do you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! We've been friends since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I also have childhood friends in other classes in this
school.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Really? Who?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, she knows Honami and Shiho...
Ah, Honami Mochizuki from class 1-B and Shiho Hinomori from 1-A.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The four of us used to be inseparable until I had to be hospitalized when we were in junior high. My hospital was really far away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm so happy to be back and reunite with old friends!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I can imagine. It'll be nice to have you in our class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! I can't wait to catch up with everyone and start hanging out again!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With everyone, huh...)
